provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED); source U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
limitations: Monthly price-level averages approximate purchasing power at daily portfolio dates.
FRED data may be revised; this download is not a full point-in-time vintage archive.

missing_observation_note: FRED CPIAUCSL is blank for October 2025; BLS reports no CPI survey data collection that month during the federal shutdown. No interpolation is used.
